major_event: Swyftx closed its Earn program, previously called Staking, on 10 January 2023 amid changing crypto-product regulatory requirements and returned assets held in Earn wallets to users' trade wallets together with earned interest

duplicate_check.notes: Promoted only after the hardened scanner classified Swyftx Earn as a duplicate-clear new candidate. The canonical record is product-scoped and does not classify the continuing Swyftx exchange as ended.
